benchmark_execution: Free standard ubuntu-24.04 GitHub-hosted VMs; local workerd/R2/SQLite only; no local measurements or paid production deployment by verifier.
source_binary_runtime_identity: Pinned full provider commit and tree refs, four distinct native source trees and native binary hashes, common runner/scorer/Worker/reference Git, strict report binary and source SHA256 ties.
fresh_state: All providers share a profile VM but use distinct Worker PIDs, state directories and report namespaces. All warmup and measured first pushes start generation 0. All sources clean after measurements.
receipts: Complete accounting, no binding failures, complete 32-push/56-fetch schedules and backend verification; fetches retain nonempty packs with strict fsck, archive and tree/want verification. Every original report and full tail retained.
counter_scope: Fixed objective prices exactly summed measured push/fetch row receipts. Whole observed workload counters also include startup and are separately labelled. No whole counter is paired with the fixed objective.
offline_reproduction: Frozen evaluator 01b36df2f5f2019eeb09ebe79eb8ae80e9f86d0cdf39667c9fec9b0584e61fb8 has unchanged evaluator source; all four scores and all six comparisons match CI byte for byte.
correlation: Intermediate suites were freshly measured once in this prospectively declared batch and are shared across all six comparisons; they are correlated observations, not additional independent pairs.
formal_result: All two-pair screen comparisons are inconclusive; no formal plateau or speed claim. Full five-pair validation is separate.
timing_limit: Client elapsed time is never inferred as billed CPU. Workerd header timing does not establish full HTTP completion.

history_selection_activation.result: Measured history-selection activation failure in both cold profiles for R10 and R11.
history_selection_activation.scope: All fresh warmups and measured trials; unchanged raw reports remain authoritative. No corrected implementation or hypothetical estimate substitutes for these samples.

source_review.observation: The pinned strict plan capability allowlist omits deepen-since and deepen-not.
source_review.coordinator_finding: Coordinator verified real Git 2.53 requests advertise those capabilities and therefore use the ordinary full path.
source_review.verification_limit: The benchmark raw reports expose actual zero activation counters and actual R2 receipts, but do not retain full HTTP request bodies to independently reconstruct the capability rejection.

history_selection_activation.formal_effect: All comparisons remain two-pair screens; activation failure establishes neither formal plateau eligibility nor a speed claim.

independent_assessment.formal_result: Every comparison is inconclusive and ineligible for plateau; every candidate has a failed latency guard in the complete screen. No promotion, acceptance, speed claim or formal plateau is supported by this attempt.

observer_physical_work.note: Actual R10/R11 final observer restore R2 GET/read-byte deltas and native history restore events are zero in this attempt because the measured history selection never activated. Zero is retained as observed; no hypothetical restoration, correction or saving is substituted. All observer receipts, including list/SQL work, remain visible and excluded from fixed and whole non-stats traffic.

independent_assessment.scope_accounting: Fixed counters and known fixed dollars cover exactly 32 pushes and 56 fetches per measured trial. Whole observer-excluded traffic includes startup and has separately named counters/dollars. All billing dimensions not measured by the runner remain null.
independent_assessment.sqlite_pages: Measured final SQLite databaseSize is 24576 bytes on every provider/profile. The frozen runner did not independently query page_size/page_count, so physical SQL page count remains null.
independent_assessment.latency_warning: Retain all tails without pruning. Local Git client elapsed time and native timing components are not billed Worker CPU or DO duration.
